ashley: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — we need concrete owners and short deadlines to turn the findings into runbook/playbook changes. Main asks: triage checklist tweaks, escalation path clarity, and a lightweight canary step before model rollouts.

chris: +1. I sketched the triage CLI checks we should add for GPU OOM / cache thrash. Minimal commands to run during triage:

chris: ```
# check GPU memory usage and processes
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.used,memory.free --format=csv
# check active inference processes and pids
ps aux | grep -E 'redwood-runtime|inference'
# dump KV cache size by shard (internal tool)
./tools/kvsize --pool=dedicated-pool-1 --format=summary
```

ravi: Nice. Can we also include a short checklist for quick mitigation that oncall can run without full context? Example: scale down batch size, enable fallback model, clear KV cache.

chris: Yep, proposed mitigation steps (short):
1) `set-batching --pool=dedicated-pool-1 --batch-size=1`
2) `route --model=redwood-lite --percent=20` (fallback)
3) `kvctl flush --prefix=prefix:session` (cache clear, non-destructive)

elen: From product side, add a line about customer-facing comms: if we hit degraded latency > 15m for >= 2 customers, PMs should be notified (ping #customer-success).

ashley: ACTIONS (short):
- ACTION: chris - add the triage commands above to the incidents runbook under "gpu/cache triage" section; add expected outputs and the `ps`/`nvidia-smi` examples. Due: 3 days.
- ACTION: ravi - author the 3-step mitigation mini-playbook (batching + fallback + cache flush) and include the exact CLI snippets. Due: 5 days.
- ACTION: elen - add communication trigger to playbook and a one-paragraph notification template for CS. Due: 4 days.
- ACTION: ashley - schedule a 30m sync to review edits and do a dry-run with oncall. Tentative: next Wed.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: last model rollout to dedicated-pool-1 was at 1912341200 by chris. Canary flag was off.

ravi: I'll also look for recurring patterns — I already ran a grep across last 6 months incidents and found 7 occurrences where eviction + high batch sizes correlated. I'll add a short analysis snippet to the postmortem doc and link it from the playbook.

chris: For the runbook format: propose adding a one-line 'severity mapping' at the top so oncall knows when to escalate to eng-runtime vs eng-sre. Example mapping:
- Sev2: latency 500-2000ms across >5% requests OR 10% increased error rate for 5m -> ping eng-runtime.
- Sev1: sustained OOMs or <1% healthy capacity -> page eng-sre and eng-runtime.

ashley: Good. Also add a short snippet for canary gating we can require before any model bump to dedicated pools:
```
# canary checklist (example)
- deploy to canary pool (2 instances)
- run synthetic load for 15m (token-level p95 < target)
- observe KV cache growth; fail if growth > 20%/min
- only promote if checks pass
```

elen: That canary gating is critical. Can we keep the canary run under 30 mins? Ops prefers <20m.

chris: We'll make the default 15m with a toggle for longer if needed. I'll add the CLI examples and a sample `canary.yml` snippet to the repo.

ashley: Wrap-up: I'll create a GitHub PR template for runbook edits that enforces: owner, short description, tests (dry-run steps), and links to postmortem. Everyone: please post your PR links in this thread when ready. We'll do the sync next Wed to walk through. :thumbsup:

ravi: Posted the preliminary recurrence notes to the postmortem doc, will link PR when mitigation mini-playbook is ready.

chris: Starting the runbook edit now. Will ping when draft PR is up.

ashley: Thanks all — tracking here so we have a single source of truth. If anyone needs me to reassign owners or change due dates ping me directly.
